Free Browser Games Platform - G123

G123 is a free online browser game platform where you can play anime-style games directly in your web browser – no downloads, installs, or registration required. Enjoy browser-based games inspired by popular anime on mobile, PC, or tablet, all playable instantly on G123. Runs smoothly on virtually any device — see System Requirements.

About G123

Browser Games Lineup

G123 offers a lineup many online browser games based on popular anime like Doraemon, Crayon Shinchan, and The Apothecary Diaries!! Discover more than 30 anime browser games and new browser-based titles released almost every month.

All Browser Games

About CTW Inc.

CTW is a NASDAQ-listed integrated internet platform service company and the operator of the G123 browser game platform. As the company behind G123, CTW publishes free-to-play browser games for players around the world.
